comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: "Suspicious mud" -- a new drop from the Chapter 2: Colossus' new Sea of Wonders zone off of Candia. More details/recipe uses found here: Sea of Wonders

comments.author: Alrn
comments.body: You need 20 of this for the new ship skill that helps for Sea of Wonders exploration (check above link for info). Based on my mutiple runs, i'd say it is very rare, so i recommend having full fleet to try to collect this.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Both ship skills:

Monster Battle Armament
Ship Lights in Foggy Seas

Mud is indeed quite rare, so it can take a while to accumulate enough to add either skill to your ship. How likely you are to do so with one or the other depends on your playstyle and goals. Cheers.

comments.author: Alrn
comments.body: Now it seems that they ease the drop rate of this item. And you can also get it from Alexandria's SOW as well.
